title: Fast, High-Accuracy, Randomized Nullspace Computations for Tall Matrices
summary: In this paper, we develop RLOBPCG, an efficient method for computing a small number of singular triplets corresponding to the smallest singular values of large, tall matrices. The algorithm combines randomized preconditioner from the sketch-and-precondition techniques with the LOBPCG eigensolver: a small sketch is used to construct a high-quality preconditioner, and LOBPCG is run on the Gram matrix to refine the singular vector.
